Turning figure 3 the same way puts its open top end on the left and its black bottom end on the right, which is option 2. Option 5 is tempting because it has the same outline, but both ends are black, so the open end is lost.
trick: For rotation questions, follow one special mark (like the black end) and see where it goes; then check every other mark still matches.
